# Template: heart_circulation
A schematic four-chamber heart in the classic double-circulation loop: lungs above, body below, deoxygenated blood in blue (body to right atrium to right ventricle to lungs) and oxygenated blood in red (lungs to left atrium to left ventricle to aorta to body), with chamber letters, optional full chamber/vessel names, and an optional septal defect with its shunt arrow. Choose this scene for ANY request about the heart's chambers, blood flow through the heart, pulmonary vs systemic circulation, the double circulation loop, oxygenated vs deoxygenated blood, or a septal defect / hole in the heart.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "labels": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Full chamber names and vessel names alongside the letters (default true)."
  },
  "show_flow": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "The six flow arrows around the loop (default true)."
  },
  "defect": {
   "type": "string",
   "enum": [
    "none",
    "septal_defect"
   ],
   "description": "septal_defect draws a hole in the ventricular septum with a left-to-right shunt arrow."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- body: the body blob at the bottom (with its caption)
- lungs: the lungs blob at the top (with its caption)
- heart: the heart outline
- walls: the septum and the atria/ventricle dividers (a group)
- right_fill: blue wash over the right heart (viewer's left)
- left_fill: red wash over the left heart
- ra: the "RA" chamber letter (right atrium; likewise rv, la, lv)
- rv: the "RV" chamber letter
- la: the "LA" chamber letter
- lv: the "LV" chamber letter
- vein_in: blue arrow, body to right atrium (vena cava)
- ra_rv: blue arrow, right atrium to right ventricle
- pulm_artery: blue arrow, right ventricle to lungs
- pulm_vein: red arrow, lungs to left atrium
- la_lv: red arrow, left atrium to left ventricle
- aorta: red arrow, left ventricle to body
- defect: the shunt arrow through the septal hole (defect only)
- label_ra: full chamber name (when labels; likewise label_rv, label_la, label_lv)
- label_vc: vessel name on the vena cava (when labels; likewise label_pa, label_pv, label_ao)
- label_defect: "Septal defect (shunt)" (defect only, when labels)
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Draw the double circulation: heart, lungs and body with the blood flow." → params: {"title":"The double circulation"}
Request: "Show a heart with a ventricular septal defect and the shunt." → params: {"defect":"septal_defect","labels":false,"title":"Ventricular septal defect"}

In YAML: `template: heart_circulation` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
